create_async_aggregator: create an AsyncAggregator instance with a global IFLModel and optional IdentityChannel for async FL
use_fed_buff_aggregator: use FedBuffAggregator to buffer client updates and step globally after reaching buffer_size threshold
configure_fed_adam_async: configure FedAdamAsyncAggregator with lr, weight_decay, beta1, beta2, and eps hyperparameters for async FL
aggregate_with_momentum: use FedAvgWithLRWithMomentumAsyncAggregator to apply momentum-scaled SGD updates on each client delta
check_aggregation_type: use AsyncAggregationType enum to choose between fed_buff_aggregation or fed_async_aggregation delta computation
